objective: Reach extremely accurate, honest initial-foot-contact timing on a declared supported subset of creator footage, with operator-verified truth and explicit abstention outside it.

truth.old_frozen_policy: May be used for diagnosis and regression only. It must never be reused as the next final validation set.

next_substantial_progress_gate.name: operator-gold challenge gate
next_substantial_progress_gate.minimum_corpus: At least 12 source-group-distinct clips, 200 clear contacts, multiple actors/cameras, side/diagonal/frontal/rear views, and at least 25% hard-negative duration; reserve a source-level locked holdout before predictions.
required: No material regression in any supported viewpoint

Behavioral tests for every fixed mechanism
Operator truth provenance and source-group split audit clean
